name: coinjoin
title: A. Private payment vs CoinJoin
summary: A denominated CoinJoin round. The coordinator witnesses inputs and outputs; the chain witnesses them forever. Anonymity-set dependent; ingress/egress joins by amount and timing remain for any chain observer.

assumptions.join_kinds: ROOT_IDENTITY | RELATIONSHIP_IDENTITY | PAIRWISE_KEY | NETWORK_IDENTIFIER | SOURCE_ENDPOINT | DEST_ENDPOINT | TRANSACTION_ID | OBLIGATION_ID | CONTEXT_ID | RELATIONSHIP_LINK | ASSET | DENOMINATION | AMOUNT | TIME | CONTENT | CONTENT_SIZE | NETWORK_LOCATION | SESSION_IDENTIFIER

provenance: Authors' model of a generic denominated equal-output CoinJoin (S11.A), 2026-09-03. Witness fields follow the disclosure any coordinator and any chain observer necessarily have.
omitted: Anonymity-set size and its variance; the model shows the joins that remain regardless of set size.
Global passive observers (out of threat model, S0).
not_better_when: You need bearer finality without any trusted counterparty. Then PaymentPluginBridge(onchain) is chosen and Molt only removes the negotiation-layer witnesses, not the chain's.
joins_remaining_notes: The intermediary learns both relationship identities; reducing this belongs to whichever credit protocol implements the step.
Counterparties know each other by construction (bounded trust, not a leak).
Settlement later via PaymentPluginBridge(onchain) is a netted aggregate: no per-payment amount or time fingerprint.
